title: Guest Suite w/ Private Bath in WeHo
description:
Enjoy easy access to Downtown and all Nashville’s major employers. Neighbors are friendly and there’s plenty to see and do by foot or bike!

This room has a private full bath, walk-in closet, full sized bed, desk and ample clothes drawers for storage.

Guests are welcome to use kitchen and living room as shared spaces with owner occupant.

Other things to note
A small dog lives here! 🐕
